BIOGRAPHY-CONTENT-1: Remains of Life is a one-man band from São Paulo, Brazil, founded by the musician Jorge Silva in 2019. It's first album, Pilgrimage, came to be in the year of 2021, presenting a pretentious and potent sound. Aggressiveness and melody blended together strongly on this work, shaping an unique identity.
BIOGRAPHY-CONTENT-2: The most recent release of the project is the EP Forlorn, which seeks a restart for the band after 3 years without any news. It is possible to identify the very same identity cited before on this work, with the determining points more firmly tied. The band does not intend to abandon its concept of uniting the extreme sound to the sublime and calm sonority, so to say.
BIOGRAPHY-CONTENT-3: These three years were an important period of reflection for pondering about the band's future and career. The eternal apprenticeship of life is what we seek to express in our music, and over this foundation Remains of Life will be upholding itself. Forlorn shall be a sign of life for the project, in order to point the way, and present the identity that we want to improve.

NEW-SINGLE-CONTENT-1: Remains of Life announces its brand new single, Shattered Mirror. This song was the first composition of the project founder, Jorge Silva. Its original arrangements, created long before the band"s conception, took short passages through the first bands which Silva featured in. As his first work, this one received a special care from its author, being invariably chosen to feature as the unique single from Remains of Life"s debut album.
NEW-SINGLE-CONTENT-2: Shattered Mirror is a slow and exceptionally melancholic song, even for the high dramatic standards of the upcoming album. Its pacing goes through melodic phrases and intense and explosive guitar arrangements. You may listen to it on the main digital platforms and in the band"s YouTube channel, where we uploaded an amazing lyric video produced by Guilherme Wolff. NEW-ALBUM: Our first album, Pilgrimage is out!
NEW-ALBUM-CONTENT-1: Close to the end of the year, our debut album is finally released by Cold Art Industry. Composed by six tracks, this masterful progressive death metal piece gives birth to a solo project created by the musician and producer Jorge Silva. Varying from heavy, distorted and fast riffs, to slow-paced acoustic melodies, and even with the presence of female vocals in some songs, this album is a great mixture of what extreme metal and soft metal ballads have of best.

CONSUMED-CONTENT: Consumed by Darkness is the second track from our debut album, Pilgrimage. Surely it's the fastest and heaviest song in this release. A song marked by insane riffs and harsh screaming, also with a surprising melodic interlude, which includes a very creative guitar solo. I decided to make a playthrough of it because it has become one of my favorites, as time has elapsed. It is important to state that in this video I made a brand new remix and remaster. Please, enjoy this one.
FORLORN-EP-CONTENT: After some years, our EP is finally released. Forlorn features three songs, which includes a new track entitled "Guilty", an acoustic version of Shattered Mirror, and a cover of one of the most insane songs ever known, Carnal Forge, by Carcass.
FORLORN-EP-CONTENT-2: Accompany the return of the project. I hope that this is a sight of good tidings for our band. The cover was designed by Tatiana Bellini, and edited by André Felipe. We are very grateful for the work of everyone involved, specially our good friend, Wilson Neto, who has borrowed his amazing voice.
